# redshift_schema (Data Source)

A database contains one or more named schemas. Each schema in a database contains tables and other kinds of named objects. By default, a database has a single schema, which is named PUBLIC. You can use schemas to group database objects under a common name. Schemas are similar to file system directories, except that schemas cannot be nested.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "redshift_schema" "schema" {
  name = "my_schema"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the schema.

### Read-Only

- `external_schema` (Attributes List) Configures the schema as an external schema. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/r_CREATE_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA.html (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_schema))
- `id` (String) The schema ID.
- `owner` (String) Name of the schema owner.
- `quota` (Number) The maximum amount of disk space that the specified schema can use. GB is the default unit of measurement.

<a id="nestedatt--external_schema"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_schema`

Read-Only:

- `data_catalog_source` (Attributes List) Configures the external schema from the AWS Glue Data Catalog (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_schema--data_catalog_source))
- `database_name` (String) The database where the external schema can be found
- `hive_metastore_source` (Attributes List) Configures the external schema from a Hive Metastore. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_schema--hive_metastore_source))
- `rds_mysql_source` (Attributes List) Configures the external schema to reference data using a federated query to RDS MYSQL or Aurora MySQL. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_schema--rds_mysql_source))
- `rds_postgres_source` (Attributes List) Configures the external schema to reference data using a federated query to RDS POSTGRES or Aurora PostgreSQL. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_schema--rds_postgres_source))
- `redshift_source` (Attributes List) Configures the external schema to reference datashare database. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_schema--redshift_source))

<a id="nestedatt--external_schema--data_catalog_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_schema.data_catalog_source`

Read-Only:

- `catalog_role_arns` (List of String) The IAM roles the cluster uses for authentication and authorization for the data catalog.
- `iam_role_arns` (List of String) The IAM roles the cluster uses for authentication and authorization.
- `region` (String) The AWS Region in which the database is located.


<a id="nestedatt--external_schema--hive_metastore_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_schema.hive_metastore_source`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String) The hostname of the hive metastore database.
- `iam_role_arns` (List of String) The IAM roles the cluster uses for authentication and authorization.
- `port` (Number) The port number of the hive metastore.


<a id="nestedatt--external_schema--rds_mysql_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_schema.rds_mysql_source`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String) The hostname of the head node of the MySQL database replica set.
- `iam_role_arns` (List of String) The IAM roles the cluster uses for authentication and authorization.
- `port` (Number) The port number of the MySQL database.
- `secret_arn` (String) The ARN of the secret holding the database credentials.


<a id="nestedatt--external_schema--rds_postgres_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_schema.rds_postgres_source`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String) The hostname of the head node of the PostgreSQL database replica set.
- `iam_role_arns` (List of String) The IAM roles the cluster uses for authentication and authorization.
- `port` (Number) The port number of the PostgreSQL database.
- `schema` (String) The name of the PostgreSQL schema.
- `secret_arn` (String) The ARN of the secret holding the database credentials.


<a id="nestedatt--external_schema--redshift_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_schema.redshift_source`

Read-Only:

- `schema` (String) The name of the datashare schema.
